narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think the row of all ones has no pattern, because nothing changes.
<bookmark mark='ones'/>But the rule of that row is to write one every time, and that is a rule.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Staying the same is also a way of following a rule.
